_comment: An orc totem's shield aura: reapplies a damage-absorbing shield of 20 HP plus 5 per level to every ally within 4.0 units every 30 ticks. A shield buff's lifetime equals its tick interval plus one, so the armor evaporates once the banner falls. Does not shield the banner itself, keeping it a priority target. All values placeholder.
name: WarbannerShield
